text.autoconfig.smarthealthindicator.opt: Passive display mode
OFF: no floating health text. DAMAGED_ONLY: only entities below full health. ALL: every living entity in range. What holding the peek key does with this is controlled by 'Peek key behavior' below.
Peek key behavior

SHOW_ALL (default): holding the peek key always shows every living entity, ignoring the configured filter. DAMAGED_ONLY: holding it always shows only damaged entities, ignoring the configured filter. USE_CONFIGURED_MODE: holding it uses 'Passive display mode' as-is, falling back to ALL only if that mode is OFF.
Show above head
Draw the health text above the entity's head.
Show at feet
Draw the health text at the entity's feet. Can be combined with 'Show above head'.
Prioritize head over feet

Only matters when both 'Show above head' and 'Show at feet' are on. Off (default): both may render at once. On: show only the head text if it has a clear line of sight; falls back to the feet text only when the head position itself is blocked (e.g. a 2-block-high space).
Show entity name
Off (default): only health text. On: also draw the entity's name on its own line above the health, for both 'Show above head' and 'Show at feet'.
Horizontal radius (blocks)
Combined X/Z distance from you. Checked independently of the vertical radius.
Vertical radius (blocks)
Y distance from you. Checked independently of the horizontal radius.
Health decimal places
0-2. Health is a float, e.g. '12.3 / 20.0' at 1 decimal place.
Use hearts instead of numbers
Off (default): show health as text (e.g. '12.3 / 20.0'). On: show it as a row of vanilla heart icons instead. Applies to both the world overlay and the crosshair line.
Full-health checkmark

Only used when 'Use hearts instead of numbers' is on. Hearts round to the nearest half-heart, so e.g. 19.7/20.0 looks identical to a genuine 20.0/20.0. On (default): mark the last heart with a small checkmark only when health truly equals max health.
Text scale
1.0 = default size. Lower to shrink the text, e.g. 0.5-0.75. Applies to both the world overlay and the crosshair line.
Combined jockey indicator

Off (default): a jockey (a living entity riding another living entity - boats/minecarts don't count) shows one line per member, like any other entity. On: shows exactly one indicator for the whole stack, cycling through each member's health every 2 seconds with a distinct color per stack position (bottom = blue-ish).
Jockey position prefix

Only has an effect while 'Combined jockey indicator' is also on. Prefixes the health line with which stack member is currently shown: B(ottom)/T(op) for 2 members; for 3+, bottom is still B, top is still T, and everything between is M1, M2, ... going up.
Show through transparent blocks

Opaque blocks (stone, dirt, doors, ...) always hide the overlay for everyone. This only controls non-occluding blocks (glass, leaves, water, ...), and only for whatever entity is currently under your crosshair: on (default), you see through them at your current target; off, any block hides it there too.
Cache health text

Off (default): health text is recomputed live every frame. On: reuse the formatted text for up to 'Cache duration' before refreshing, to reduce cost with many nearby entities. Entity presence/range is always checked live regardless of this setting.
Cache duration (ms)
0-1000ms. Only used when 'Cache health text' is on. Expires by real time, not game ticks, so a laggy server can't leave it stuck showing stale numbers.
Show hostile mobs
Entities whose mob category is not friendly (zombies, skeletons, ...).
Show passive mobs
Entities whose mob category is friendly (cows, villagers, ...).
Show other players
Other players in the world. Does not affect yourself - see 'Show self' below.
Show self
Off (default): never show an indicator for your own client player. On: also show one for yourself, e.g. useful in third-person view.
Entity type list mode
BLACKLIST (default): show everything except the list below. WHITELIST: show only what's in the list below - an empty list then shows nothing.
Entity type list
Exact registry IDs, e.g. 'minecraft:zombie'. Case-insensitive. Meaning depends on 'Entity type list mode' above. Applies on top of the hostile/passive toggles above.
Player name list mode
BLACKLIST (default): show every player except the list below. WHITELIST: show only the players in the list below - an empty list then shows nobody.
Player name list
Exact usernames. Case-insensitive. Meaning depends on 'Player name list mode' above.
Show crosshair line
On (default): show the name and health of whatever living entity you are looking at, within your interaction reach - name on its own line above the health.
